target_text:
// The packed K plane (Note [K VNNI storage]) follows the same rules. The AMX
  // kernels reject its view (the AVX-512 reader k_vnni::qk_group takes it).
body:
**[comments] Rule 2, restates identifiers: shorten**

"Views come only from an owner. A writable view converts to a read-only one only." repeats two of the rules that "follows the same rules" already points at (spelled out for V at 389-400) and restates the is_constructible / is_convertible probes at 423-426. The first two sentences carry the one new fact: the AMX kernels reject this view because it is qk_group's operand.

Proposed:
```cpp
  // The packed K plane (Note [K VNNI storage]) follows the same rules. The AMX
  // kernels reject its view (the AVX-512 reader k_vnni::qk_group takes it).
```
